# Safi Ghauri

> Safi Ghauri is a crypto lawyer, Barrister of Lincoln's Inn, and geopolitical
> analyst. He is Managing Partner of Esquare Legal, a crypto-native law firm
> with offices in the UAE, Brazil, Pakistan and China, and a Partner of Tahota
> Law Firm, one of China's top-100 global law firms. He is a member of the
> European Commission/UNIDROIT Digital Assets Roundtable of Experts (DARTE).
> Based in São Paulo, Brazil; works regularly from Dubai and Islamabad.

Key facts:
- Practice: crypto and Web3 regulation, VARA, MiCA, DFSA and ADGM FSRA
  licensing, stablecoins, RWA tokenization, cross-border capital structuring
- Qualified: Barrister, Lincoln's Inn; registered to practise in Brazil
- Media: quoted by The Independent (UK), Bloomberg Arabic (Asharq Business),
  CNA (Channel NewsAsia), Reuters, Gulf News, China Business Law Journal,
  TechRound, FinanceFeeds
- Broadcast: 300+ appearances as political analyst on PTV World; officially
  appointed PTV World South America Correspondent, based in São Paulo
- Speaking: Horasis Global Summit, COP30, European Commission and UNIDROIT
  DARTE expert series, ETH LATAM, Stellar Meridian, Web3Experts Brazil,
  UNODC, FATF
- Languages: English, Urdu, Chinese, Portuguese
- Also known as: Safi Ullah Ghauri, Safiullah Ghauri, Barrister Safi Ullah
  Ghauri — all refer to the same person
